status_changes.new_status: answered for the stated parameter range
status_changes.result: Fixed nonlinear degree is summed at subunit radius, followed by its radial Abel limit; the outer degree sum converges ordinarily and absolutely to the angular zero with an explicit geometric error.
limits: The threshold 6 is sufficient, not asserted optimal.
No ordinary convergence of the fully flattened multiset transseries is claimed.
The predecessor's divergence result is preserved.

status_changes.result: A specified finite frequency-and-degree truncation attains exp(-lambda*a^2 + O_lambda(a)) error for every 0 < lambda < log(3/2), uniformly in b > 0 and 0 < rho <= 1 for sufficiently large a.
limits: No sharp optimum for the original exponential-base cutoff is established.
No computational optimality is asserted; the frequency cutoff grows exponentially.

status_changes.result: Both hyperbolic amplitudes are proved with locally uniform complex-coupling error; an analytic-core universality theorem and the first relative correction are supplied.
limits: Classical Lagrange inversion and the source's finite coefficient formula are credited.
The statement remains additive at zeros of a leading parity amplitude.

status_changes.source_target: thm:inverse-gevrey and the subsequent Borel-scope discussion
status_changes.prior_status: sharp positive-real Borel radius and a negative-axis singularity established
status_changes.result: Both nearest logarithmic Borel endpoints are identified for every nonzero complex coupling; an exact initial-disk log/dilog decomposition has a remainder and first derivative continuous on the closed disk.
limits: No continuation outside the initial Borel disk is proved.
No full singularity classification or alien-derivative statement is asserted.

status_changes.prior_status: convergent local charts and qualitative branch types established
status_changes.result: For noninteger rational alpha=s-1=p/q, the minimum local ramification degree is min(p,q); irrational alpha and integer s >= 2 have no finite ramifying cover. The inverse endpoint is holomorphic exactly at s=1+1/q, integer q >= 2.
limits: This is local branch regularization, not a global classification of all inverse sheets.
The existing quadratic-feedback ramification results concern a different implicit function and are credited.

status_changes.source_target: Further research question 9 and the integer cut-modulus ingredient lem:cutgap
status_changes.prior_status: the integer result is proved; corresponding all-real endpoint-circle geometry is open
status_changes.new_status: all-real extension of the cut-modulus ingredient disproved; full global question remains open here
status_changes.result: For 1 < s < 3/2, |Li_s(exp(u)+i0)| < zeta(s) for all sufficiently small positive u; for s >= 3/2 the opposite local strict inequality holds.
limits: No established integer-order theorem is contradicted.
Failure of the cut-modulus inequality does not by itself determine the true inverse Taylor radius.
The full endpoint-circle question is not marked solved or disproved.
